name: shiksha-teacher-roster-tutorial
title: Review learners and their work

chapters.caption: 01  Open Dashboard and confirm the course before reviewing its learners.
02  My Students shows the roster and the course plan side by side.
03  Select a learner and expand a concept. In progress is not a mastery claim.
04  Switch to Topics to read the learner's recorded work against the syllabus.
05  Open Assets to read the saved example, with navigation already collapsed.
06  Close the preview to return to the same learner and their course work.

description: Open the real course dashboard, inspect a synthetic learner's concepts and syllabus topics, and review one saved document without claiming mastery.
capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
